test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SNOW' is coded as '21, 16, 17, 25', 'RIDE' is coded as '20, 11, 6, 7'. What is the code for 'TAPE' in that code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] Logic: Place value of Opposite letter + 2 = Code of that letter. Now, 'SNOW' is coded as '21, 16, 17, 25' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7979cf09bd0a33c9e414105d0ad6c4acaa5671895927d260241bb55f4ce38644.png]
